verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that a live llms.txt is served at docs.pipecat.ai. Pipecat also ships other agent-oriented doc surfaces: `pipecat context-hub` registers a local docs/examples/API index as an MCP server for coding agents (confirmed in a runtime probe), the quickstart scaffold writes AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, and the OpenAPI spec is framed as something to 'feed to AI tools'. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of agents consuming llms.txt or the context hub in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: pipecat context-hub install registers the hub as an MCP server with your coding agent and builds the local index
context-hub (local docs/examples/API index built for coding agents)
Install the Pipecat CLI and scaffold the quickstart project (also writes AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md)
Download the complete spec to generate clients, run mocks, or feed to AI tools.
